issue.title: TSBC-1543 runnable-cell sweep - Grok 4.3 excluding TSBC-1484 carve-out
issue.description:
Parent: [TSBC-1543](/TSBC/issues/TSBC-1543).

Grok burn constraints from the parent mandate:

- Use CLI subscription surfaces only; never use or request a console/API key.
- Respect `/Users/glad0s/paperclip/benchmark/.tsbc-power.json` and keep `maxConcurrentRuns=1` for this lane.
- Preserve source plus render under `work-products/TSBC-1543/<this issue identifier>/` or the established [TSBC-1141](/TSBC/issues/TSBC-1141) matrix root when the runner requires it.
- Upload attachment-or-fail artifacts before closing: raw rows/session evidence, ledger delta or reconciliation note, machine-readable verdict, and mandatory branded `TSBC-<issue>-report.pdf` if this is treated as a TSBC benchmark/test closeout.
- Do not duplicate [TSBC-1542](/TSBC/issues/TSBC-1542); this packet is text-benchmark work only.
- Nothing publishes and no live routing changes are allowed.

If the target cell is already decision-grade, do not rerun it. Attach a reconciliation report citing exact artifact paths/issues and spend only genuinely useful remaining budget on the next listed runnable cell.

Priority work:

1. Reconcile `grok-4.3` rows from [TSBC-1269](/TSBC/issues/TSBC-1269) auditor `120/120`, [TSBC-1270](/TSBC/issues/TSBC-1270) ops `100/100`, and local [TSBC-1394](/TSBC/issues/TSBC-1394) mixed raw rows.
2. Do not try to solve or substitute the blocked [TSBC-1484](/TSBC/issues/TSBC-1484) cell. Treat the [TSBC-1475](/TSBC/issues/TSBC-1475) R1 `paperclip` full cell as carve-out candidate until the parent checks it after 20:00 local time.
3. Spend this lane only on runnable non-[TSBC-1484](/TSBC/issues/TSBC-1484) gaps: recency reconciliation, CV-review/ops/auditor supplemental probes if they are still below decision grade, and served-model/session evidence banking.
4. Attach an explicit carve-out line if the only missing cell remains the [TSBC-1484](/TSBC/issues/TSBC-1484) fixture route.

Close with `locked_except_TSBC-1484` if no other runnable gap remains.

---
Before you finish, the FINAL line of your response MUST be your chosen disposition as JSON — Paperclip records your decision from this line even if a status PATCH fails. If blocked, include a short `blocker` describing what must be resolved first: PAPERCLIP_DISPOSITION: {"status":"done|cancelled|in_review|blocked","hasBlocker":true|false,"blocker":"<short reason, only when blocked>"}
